events.title: Al-Muizz Street at Golden Hour
events.includes: Guiding, Arabic coffee at the end
events.description: Walk the full length of Al-Muizz li-Din Allah Street from Bab al-Futuh to Bab Zuweila as the sun sets over a thousand years of minarets. We stop at the Qalawun complex, Beit al-Suhaymi and the Al-Aqmar mosque, with stories of the Fatimid and Mamluk city.
events.what_to_bring: Comfortable shoes, water, modest clothing for mosque visits
events.cancellation_policy: Free event — please cancel in the app if you cannot come.

events.title: Khan el-Khalili Food Crawl
events.description: Eight tastings in three hours: ful and taameya, hawawshi, feteer, sobia, roz bel laban and the legendary El Fishawy tea. Vegetarian options at every stop.
events.cancellation_policy: Full refund up to 48 hours before.

events.title: Coptic Cairo & the Religions Compound
events.description: The Hanging Church, Abu Serga, the Ben Ezra Synagogue and the Mosque of Amr ibn al-As — two thousand years of faith within a few hundred metres.
events.cancellation_policy: Full refund up to 24 hours before.

events.title: Downtown Belle Époque Architecture Walk
events.description: Khedival Cairo's Paris-on-the-Nile: Talaat Harb, Emad El-Din, the Cosmopolitan Hotel and hidden passages full of Art Deco details.
events.meeting_address: Talaat Harb Square, by the statue
events.cancellation_policy: Full refund up to 24 hours before.

events.title: Women's Sunrise Photo Walk in Zamalek
events.description: A calm, women-only morning shooting the Nile, the Cairo Tower and Zamalek's villas in the soft first light. Composition tips for phones and cameras.
events.cancellation_policy: Full refund up to 24 hours before.

events.title: Wadi Degla Canyon Hike
events.description: A 10 km loop through the limestone canyon of Wadi Degla protectorate, looking for fossils and desert foxes. Steady pace with regular breaks.
events.what_to_bring: 2L water, snacks, hat, sunscreen, hiking shoes
events.cancellation_policy: Free event — please cancel if you can't make it.

events.title: Al-Azhar Park Family Walk & Picnic
events.description: An easy loop around Al-Azhar Park with views of the Citadel and the Ayyubid wall, then a picnic on the lawns. Kids welcome.
events.what_to_bring: Picnic blanket, snacks, park entry ticket
events.meeting_address: Al-Azhar Park main gate, Salah Salem
events.cancellation_policy: Free event.

events.title: The Citadel & Sultan Hassan
events.description: From the Mosque of Sultan Hassan and Al-Rifai to the Citadel of Salah al-Din and the Muhammad Ali Mosque, with the best view in Cairo.
events.cancellation_policy: Full refund up to 24 hours before.

events.title: Bab Zuweila & the Tentmakers' Street
events.description: Climb the minarets of Bab Zuweila, then photograph the appliqué artisans of Al-Khayamiya, Cairo's last covered market.
events.cancellation_policy: Full refund up to 24 hours before.

events.title: Sayeda Zeinab Late-Night Street Food
events.description: Koshary, kebda Iskandarani, mombar and a sweet finish with basbousa — Cairo eats after dark.
events.cancellation_policy: Full refund up to 48 hours before.

events.title: Pyramids Desert Plateau Walk
events.description: A desert walk across the Giza plateau to the panorama point, away from the crowds, finishing at the Sphinx.
events.cancellation_policy: Full refund up to 48 hours before.

events.title: Saqqara & Dahshur Day Trip
events.includes: Transport from Cairo, lunch, entry tickets
events.description: The Step Pyramid of Djoser, the Serapeum and the Bent and Red Pyramids of Dahshur — the pyramids before Giza.
events.cancellation_policy: 50% refund up to 72 hours before.

events.title: Qaitbay Citadel & Anfoushi Sea Walk
events.description: From the Citadel of Qaitbay, built on the ruins of the Pharos lighthouse, along the fishermen's harbour of Anfoushi.
events.cancellation_policy: Full refund up to 24 hours before.

events.title: Alexandria Seafood & Sweets Walk
events.description: Fried fish in Anfoushi, Mohamed Ahmed's ful, Délices pastries and Sabry ice-cream — Alexandria by the mouthful.
events.cancellation_policy: Full refund up to 48 hours before.

events.title: Montazah Gardens Sunset Walk
events.description: An easy stroll through the royal gardens of Montazah to the palace and the sea at sunset.
events.cancellation_policy: Free event.

events.title: Bibliotheca & Roman Alexandria
events.description: The new Library of Alexandria, the Roman Amphitheatre of Kom el-Dikka and Pompey's Pillar.
events.cancellation_policy: Full refund up to 24 hours before.

events.title: Wadi El Rayan Waterfalls & Magic Lake
events.description: Day trip to the only waterfalls in Egypt's Western Desert, sandboarding on the dunes and sunset at the Magic Lake.
events.cancellation_policy: 50% refund up to 72 hours before.

events.title: Tunis Village Pottery Weekend
events.description: Two days in the potters' village on Lake Qarun: a pottery workshop, a sunset walk on the lake shore and a night in an eco-lodge.
events.cancellation_policy: 50% refund up to 7 days before.

events.title: Wadi Al-Hitan Fossils & Stargazing
events.description: Walk among 40-million-year-old whale skeletons at the UNESCO site, then camp under the darkest skies near Cairo.
events.cancellation_policy: 50% refund up to 7 days before.

events.title: Siwa Oasis 4-Day Escape
events.description: Salt lakes, the Shali fortress, Cleopatra's spring, the Great Sand Sea and a Bedouin dinner under the stars.
events.what_to_bring: Swimwear, scarf, warm layer for nights
events.cancellation_policy: 50% refund up to 14 days before.

events.title: Siwa Salt Lakes Float & Sunset
events.description: Float in the turquoise salt pools, then catch the sunset at Fatnas island.
events.what_to_bring: Swimwear, towel, fresh water to rinse
events.cancellation_policy: Full refund up to 48 hours before.

events.title: Dahab Blue Hole Coastal Hike
events.description: A coastal trail from the Blue Hole towards Ras Abu Galum with snorkelling breaks along the reef.
events.cancellation_policy: Full refund up to 48 hours before.

events.title: Mount Sinai Sunrise Trek
events.includes: Bedouin guide, tea at the summit
events.description: Night ascent of Mount Sinai via the camel path, sunrise at the summit and descent by the 3,750 Steps of Repentance to St. Catherine's Monastery.
events.cancellation_policy: Full refund up to 72 hours before.

events.title: Al-Muizz by Night
events.description: The lit-up mosques and sabils of Al-Muizz after dark.

events.title: Wadi Degla Sunset Hike
events.description: Short canyon hike timed for sunset over the cliffs.

events.title: Downtown Cafés & Bakeries
events.description: Groppi, Café Riche, Le Grillon and a few bakeries locals swear by.

reviews.comment: Nour brings every building to life. Already booked the next one.
